correctness.rationale: Exactly (3!)^6=46,656 complete strict 3-by-3 preference profiles and all six bijections per profile were independently enumerated with explicit two-sided blocking-pair checks. Calculated lex-max profile (p1,p2,p3), Nash product 3^p1 2^p2, and ratio P*/PR using exact fractions; obtained exactly seven cells 1:42756, 4/3:2484, 16/9:432, 64/27:12, 8/3:828, 32/9:72, 16/3:72. The stable-match count distribution was 34080 one, 11484 two, 1092 three; optimal sets coincide for 42756 and are disjoint for 3900, none partially overlap. The simple n=2 identity P=2^p1 gives universal ratio 1. Since this is the entire finite domain, the exact enumeration is an exhaustive certificate rather than a partial experiment.
residual_risks: Numerical theorem restricted to strict complete 3×3 and utility 3,2,1, not larger markets.

A published three-pair Resultary classification ranks maximal versus egalitarian stable marriage and shares some frequency counts, but the *additive* egalitarian objective does not imply the exact multiplicative seven-atom ratio law. No explicit stronger implication was identified; the recent Nash paper was not fully accessible, so the priority judgment remains qualified.
